newsitem.title: UK: Stg only one factor behind monetary policy - Clarke.
newsitem.headline: Stg only one factor behind monetary policy - Clarke.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Monday the pound's exchange rate was only one of many factors taken into account when setting monetary policy.
"The exchange rate value of sterling is only one of the very many things we look at when setting monetary policy...one part of an overall picture," Clarke told the Treasury select committee.
"We don't have a target rate for sterling," he added.
"We have no alternative but to see where the markets take us and to take that into account in setting our monetary policy," Clarke said.
Clarke also said low inflation is essential to the sustainability of a healthy economic recovery.
